_comment: Board game shelf data. Each game has an array of tag ids (defined in 'tags') and an owners array (legacy owner strings are also supported). Length tag uses max play time: short <=30, medium 31-60, long >60. Complexity tag uses BGG weight: light <2, medium 2-2.9, heavy >=3. Player counts are numeric (playersMin/playersMax); the page filters on 1–5 players individually and '6+' by playersMax >= 6. link.type is 'game' (direct BGG page) or 'search'.
